1: chhandānsi yasya parṇāni yas taṁ veda sa veda-vit ||
3: nānto na chādir na cha sampratiṣhṭhā |
6: na tad bhāsayate sūryo na śhaśhāṅko na pāvakaḥ |
yad gatvā na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṁ mama ||
8: śharīraṁ yad avāpnoti yach chāpy utkrāmatīśhvaraḥ |
9: śhrotraṁ chakṣhuḥ sparśhanaṁ cha rasanaṁ ghrāṇam eva cha |
10: utkrāmantaṁ sthitaṁ vāpi bhuñjānaṁ vā guṇānvitam |
11: yatanto yoginaśh chainaṁ paśhyanty ātmany avasthitam |
12: yach chandramasi yach chāgnau tat tejo viddhi māmakam ||
13: gām āviśhya cha bhūtāni dhārayāmy aham ojasā |
puṣhṇāmi chauṣhadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ ||
14: ahaṁ vaiśhvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṁ deham āśhritaḥ |
15: vedaiśh cha sarvair aham eva vedyo |
16: dvāv imau puruṣhau loke kṣharaśh chākṣhara eva cha |
17: uttamaḥ puruṣhas tv anyaḥ paramātmety udāhṛitaḥ |
yo loka-trayam āviśhya bibharty avyaya īśhvaraḥ ||
18: yasmāt kṣharam atīto ’ham akṣharād api chottamaḥ |
ato ’smi loke vede cha prathitaḥ puruṣhottamaḥ ||
19: yo mām evam asammūḍho jānāti puruṣhottamam |
sa sarva-vid bhajati māṁ sarva-bhāvena bhārata ||
20: iti guhyatamaṁ śhāstram idam uktaṁ mayānagha |
etad buddhvā buddhimān syāt kṛita-kṛityaśh cha bhārata ||
